summary: PNG IEND (image end) chunk handler. Reads the image-state flag register at this+0x58 and, when both the bit 0 (0x1) and bit 2 (0x4) flags are set (image data present), sets the done bits 0x18, warns through CallbackDispatch with the 'Incorrect IEND chunk length' string when the chunk length a3 is non-zero, and runs the CRC error check sub_518828 before returning its result. When either flag is clear it calls GuardedCallWithLongjmp with the 'No image in file' string and returns its result when a2 is zero.

local_names.a2: guard input tested after the longjmp guard call
local_names.v3: image-state flag register value at this+0x58

operations.description: Read the image-state flag register dword at this+0x58 into v3

Guard: the image-present branch requires both bit 0 (0x1, IHDR seen) and bit 2 (0x4, IDAT seen) set; when either is clear, GuardedCallWithLongjmp(a1, 'No image in file') is evaluated into result and the block still runs when a2 is non-zero
Set the done bits 0x18 on the flag register at this+0x58 (unconditional inside the image-present branch)
Guard: when the IEND chunk length a3 is non-zero, dispatch the 'Incorrect IEND chunk length' warning through CallbackDispatch(a1, ...)
Run the CRC error check sub_518828(a1, a3); its return value is returned as the function result
Return: when the guard fails, return the GuardedCallWithLongjmp result; called from sub_5119E9 (0x005119E9)
